activities.activity_description: Investigate how to include/exclude message bus/binding jars and implement the binding selection and fallback mechanism when none is setup (U1).
Add support for dependency resolution to handle conflicting jar versions across different modules at runtime (U2).
Configure CI/CD pipeline to build and publish the s-c-d image to DockerHub for incremental commits (U3).
Prepare demo environment, run the firehose/counter pipe, and record a public screencast demonstrating s-c-s (U4).
Determine a consistent undeploy strategy for jobs and streams, and implement the undeploy operation for singlenode (single JVM) (U5).
Add support for profiles to the core Admin application to back the stream repository with respective backend strategies, such as an in-memory strategy for the local profile (U6).
